name: The Way The Truth And The Life
overview: Scripture reveals Jesus Christ as the ultimate revelation of God, embodying the Word who existed from the beginning and is Himself God. He is the only way to eternal life, as belief in Him grants everlasting life while rejection results in remaining under God's wrath. Jesus declares Himself the light that guides out of darkness and the source of truth that brings freedom. His invitation challenges followers to remain steadfast, affirming that knowing Him is essential for spiritual life and liberty.
